en.title: Minister Uraloğlu announces: High-speed train era in Thrace begins on October 9
en.summary: Transport and Infrastructure Minister Abdulkadir Uraloğlu announced that the 153-kilometer Çerkezköy-Kapıkule High-Speed Train Line will open on October 9. The line will reduce passenger travel time between Halkalı and Kapıkule from 4 hours to 1.5 hours and freight transport time from 8.5 hours to 3.5 hours.

en.title: High interest in mackerel: Both weight and price increased
en.summary: Mackerel supply in Trabzon has increased with larger fish sizes appearing on market stalls. Fish weight has grown from 300-500 grams at season start to up to 1 kilogram, while prices have risen 20-50 Turkish Lira to reach 100-150 Turkish Lira range.
